generation.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile UI/UX storyboard for the Strength Ledger Self-Coach mobile redesign proposal.
Create a polished product design board, wide landscape canvas, large legible front-facing iPhone screens side by side, straight-on with equal scale and no perspective. Minimal thin phone outlines, no hands or desktop props. Above phones a restrained board title. Below each phone a numbered step caption and concise action connector. Phone screens should occupy most of the image, with minimal outer margins. Excellent readable UI typography, exact spelled interface labels, practical mobile spacing and full safe areas. All scenes are proposed mobile screens, with fictional data.
Visual system shared across every panel: dark brushed gunmetal background near #10181d with extremely subtle iron texture, layered charcoal surfaces around #202b33, soft off-white readable type, muted lavender/violet primary actions, precise green saved status, cyan rest timing, amber for pending actions. Refined surface depth with quiet edges, compact density and clean SF Pro-like typography. Premium, comfortable, athletic and professional. Restrained real movement photography can blend into a background with feathered edges and a protected fully visible subject. No square movement thumbnails, no neon glow, no purple atmospheric circles, no pastel backgrounds, no glass spaceship styling, no busy decorations, no fake SL medallion, no decorative charts without axes. Small wordmark reads "STRENGTH LEDGER".
All main destination screens use a bottom navigation with three clearly labeled items "Train", "Plan", "Progress". Main destination title remains visible. A full-screen exercise picker or active workout uses a natural local Back or close control. Do not add extra navigation tiers. Primary actions have comfortable thumb targets without gigantic padding.
Board footer text verbatim "DESIGN PROPOSAL · EXAMPLE DATA".
Board title verbatim "01  YOUR FIRST WORKOUT".
Four screens in left-to-right sequence, each tall portrait mobile proportion. Give each screen enough height and text legibility.
Screen 1, first arrival after the Self-Coach account is ready. Header small wordmark and profile avatar, title "Train". One bold warm headline "Ready when you are." Short sentence "Start a workout. Build from there." Main button "Start workout" and quieter "Build a routine". A tasteful wide iron barbell detail gently integrated into the lower background, no boxed screenshot or decorative data cards. Bottom navigation Train selected. No fabricated training history, rest-day diagnosis, bodyweight questions or empty dashboard charts.
Screen 2, exercise picker. Back arrow, title "Add exercise", prominent search field with typed "bench". Search covers all exercises. Small optional filter "Equipment". Clean matching result "Bench Press" with supporting label "Barbell · Chest", and second result "Incline Bench Press" with same useful secondary details. A small visible "Add" action beside the first result is selected. Simple list with no square photos. Lower helpful text "Search every exercise in one place."
Screen 3, active workout. Back to Train at top, title "Workout" and compact elapsed time "06:12". Exercise title "Bench Press", small inline "Barbell" context, authentic visible bench-press lifter/background imagery in a protected upper-right area, subtle enough to preserve text. Compact previous-history text "No previous sets". Table fields "Set", "lb", "Reps". A single editable first set row "1" "135" "5". A clear violet "Save set" action. Below, low-emphasis "+ Add set" and "+ Add exercise". Compact cyan rest timer control shows "Rest off" before any saved set. A clear "Finish" action is reachable. Optional "Effort" is a secondary field, not a required page.
Screen 4, first workout completed. Header "Workout saved" with a small green confirmation mark. "Bench Press", "135 lb × 5". Two compact summary facts "1 set" and "1 exercise", with "675 lb volume" accurately calculated from 135×5. Main useful option "Save as routine", secondary "View workout" and a clear "Done" control. No arbitrary award, PR or trend for this first workout.
Step captions below phones verbatim "1  Start", "2  Choose an exercise", "3  Record your set", "4  Save and reuse". Small arrows connect the panels. Match exact numbers and labels across panels.
